description: GT3 英文/缩写 CMU 音素扰动的单项音频扰动实验：复用 clean CMU TTS，仅运行五种单项后处理和同一 ASR 解码条件。
output_readme:
# GT3 English CMU single-augmentation experiment

Input: all English/acronym GT terms from `resources/gt3-by-type/english-word-acronym.txt`.

Upstream reuse: 359 clean CMU/CosyVoice TTS samples from `gt3-english-cmu-cosy-clean`.

Test: exactly one audio perturbation per sample: speed 0.90, speed 1.10, white noise at 18 dB SNR, low-pass at 3200 Hz, and hard clipping at 0.35. The clean source audio is intentionally excluded because it is already evaluated in the upstream experiment.

Expected ASR inputs: 1,795 (359 x 5). ASR: managed WSL Qwen3-ASR, temperature 0.65, top_p 1.0, top_k 50, min_p 0.0, seed null.

Outputs: `augmentation/`, `asr-input-manifest.jsonl`, `results/`, and `report/`.
